create_file_audio_dataset: create a FileAudioDataset from a manifest file with configurable sample rate, padding, and normalization options
create_binarized_audio_dataset: create a BinarizedAudioDataset from a binarized data directory with split, sample rate, and bucket settings
collate_audio_samples: collate a batch of audio samples into padded tensors with optional bucketing and precomputed masks
postprocess_audio_features: postprocess raw audio feature tensors by converting stereo to mono and applying layer normalization
compute_block_mask_indices: compute 1D block mask indices for audio features using configurable mask probability, length, and dropout
